label: 🧩 Sub-pipeline
description: Embed another saved pipeline as a single step. Output of the referenced pipeline becomes this step's output. Recursive references are detected and rejected.

pipeline_id.label: Pipeline ID
pipeline_id.help: ID of a saved pipeline. Open the target pipeline and copy its ID from the URL.

output_id.label: Output ID (optional)
output_id.help: Which named output of the referenced pipeline to use. Defaults to the first / only output.

sample_rows.label: Sample rows (optional)
sample_rows.help: Cap the rows pulled from the sub-pipeline. Useful when the inner pipeline is large and you only need a preview.
